scope: Focused follow-ups from actual candidate measurements; no speculative production fixes included

items.readiness: Block inherited external-sampler topology until resolved
items.finding: Four fresh-child controls passed; four inherited external SamplerEngine cases timed out at 15 s (mmap/direct x cold/warm). All eight children were reaped.
items.origin: The external API predates this port; regression introduction is unproven without baseline evidence.
items.change: Construct external SamplerEngine in each worker, or reject inherited access at the public history boundary with a clear error.
acceptance: Reproduce all four actual parallel inherited cases in a finite regression; each must either complete with validated work or reject promptly under the chosen documented contract.
Retain four fresh-child controls, current serial coverage, seeded-work and prediction parity.
No inherited PID or thread-pool state may silently bypass the fork guard.
items.evidence: Distinct final-core qualification proof c05170ba; retained in finalization supplement, separate from performance archive.

items.readiness: Measured optimization candidate; no speedup promised
items.finding: 707/6132 weighted CPU training samples contain getpid; cached-range access is the largest directly observed caller class. 56 generic-thread-root samples remain source-unattributed.
items.change: Evaluate operation-scoped validation that reduces repeated cached-range guards while preserving ownership checks at access, response, drop and process-state boundaries.
acceptance: Preserve MADV_DONTFORK and actual child-process ownership safety; no unchecked cached or thread-local PID inheritance.
Pass native ownership/fork tests and current seed/work/prediction oracles.
Repeat paired full-work CPU/E2E measurements and show where time moved; sample fractions are not a predicted speedup.

items.readiness: Causality experiment needed before changing concurrency
items.finding: Cold Direct has 85.08% target zero-dispatched time despite busy mean depth 69.64. CPU leaves include row/header decode and memcpy; model main waits in Rayon feature accumulation and prepared-page finish.
items.change: Separate decode/materialization and batch-feeding costs, then test one bounded concurrency change at a time.
acceptance: Fix data epoch, seed, full training work, predictions, cache/memory/CPU controls.
Measure model and worker CPU/waits, full-window and busy-window block depth, physical IOPS and fit/first-predict E2E.
A higher queue alone is not success; require reproducible E2E improvement with unchanged correctness and explicit variability.

items.finding: Stable fio cells demonstrate high throughput, but both complete curves classify INCONCLUSIVE_VARIABILITY. Issuer count improves equal nominal-depth performance.
items.change: Repeat variable cells and compare a matched read-size/pattern window before attributing a plateau to controller/media capacity.
acceptance: Retain five repetitions, issuer CPU and both issued/completed fio counts.
Inspect every SMART thermal duration/transition counter delta and snapshot temperature; between-snapshot peaks remain unobserved.
Keep fio application IOPS, block completions and NVMe command counts distinct; no percentage of vendor maximum without a valid denominator.

items.finding: Paired E2E differences range -6.08% to +11.88%; first principal attempt failed final drain amid foreign reads. Fresh 70-run v2 passed after quiet-host discipline and 60 s final drain.
items.change: Use finite quiet capture windows, strict unchanged diagnostics/drain validation and all five none/queue pairs.
acceptance: Report training and fit/first-predict paired differences, including negatives; no after-the-fact overhead cutoff or correction.
Do not run artifact walks, builds, imports or monitoring scans on the measured host during captures.
Keep drain outside measured clocks and retain any failed attempt separately.
